record.captures_are_retained_where_they_were_wr: The three captures and the run record are not committed. They are bound here by size and SHA-256 so that a copy presented later can be shown to be the one this record describes.
record.condition: A RUN AGAINST A PRIVATE STORE IS A TRUE MEASUREMENT OF A COMPOSED WORLD AND IS NOT A MEASUREMENT OF WHAT THE PRODUCT SERVES.
record.profile_note: A supplement, not a correction. The run record it binds is retained unedited.

store.database: a PostgreSQL server private to one worktree, started by scripts/test_postgres.py
store.directory: a directory owned by one session, outside the repository and outside any shared store

record.what_is_identical_to_a_product_bake: The containers were produced by scripts/bake_corridor_tiles.py, the repository's own publish path, unmodified, from documents generated by the repository's own city generation. Each was baked twice and both passes were byte identical. The same five containers were independently produced a second time from a scratch directory on an earlier tree, and all fifteen digests agree container for container.
record.why_this_record_exists: The run record binds four container digests, the stated walk, the harness and the pose, and carries no field anywhere for the store behind the API it read. Its servedBy field states what the runner was told and binds nothing. A reader meeting it alone would take it for a run against the store the product serves. It is not one.
